campaigns.name: Git-First Publishing
campaigns.objective: signups — drive developers to sign up by highlighting frictionless, code-friendly publishing
campaigns.big_idea: Position lettercraft as the only newsletter tool that truly respects a developer's workflow. Emphasize writing in Markdown, versioning with Git, and pushing to publish — no more copy-paste fights with clunky editors.
campaigns.hook: Write your newsletter like you write your code.

sample_copy.headline: Your newsletter belongs in Git, not a WYSIWYG trap.
sample_copy.body: Write in Markdown. Edit in your IDE. Publish with a git push. Syntax-highlighted code blocks that actually work in every inbox. No lock-in. Just git clone to leave.
sample_copy.cta: Start with a repo, not a signup.

assets_needed: Short demo video of git push to publish
Screenshot of code block rendering across email clients
campaigns.success_metric: Number of Show HN upvotes and resulting signups
campaigns.why_on_brand: Uses plainspoken, developer-native tone and anti-lock-in messaging directly from the brand voice and key differentiators.

campaigns.name: Code Block Confidence
campaigns.objective: awareness — build credibility around flawless code rendering
campaigns.big_idea: Leverage the published 14-client test matrix as proof that lettercraft solves a real pain point. Turn technical validation into a marketing asset.
campaigns.hook: Your code blocks shouldn’t break in Gmail.

sample_copy.headline: We tested code blocks in 14 email clients so you don’t have to.
sample_copy.body: Most platforms fail. We verify. lettercraft renders syntax-highlighted, copyable code in every major email client — and we publish the test matrix so you can trust it.
sample_copy.cta: See the test results and try it yourself.

campaigns.why_on_brand: Highlights proof points observed in APP_PROFILE and speaks with technical precision developers trust.

campaigns.name: Own Your Audience
campaigns.objective: signups — appeal to users tired of platform lock-in
campaigns.big_idea: Frame content and subscriber ownership as a fundamental right. Contrast one-click export and git clone freedom with competitors’ walled gardens.
campaigns.hook: What if you actually owned your newsletter?

sample_copy.headline: Your subscribers aren’t theirs. Your content isn’t theirs. Why is it locked in their platform?
sample_copy.body: With lettercraft, your posts are Markdown files in your Git repo. Your list exports in one click. No gatekeepers. No surprise fees. Just your audience, your way.
sample_copy.cta: Move your newsletter to Git today.

campaigns.why_on_brand: Echoes the anti-lock-in stance and developer-native language central to the brand.

campaigns.name: From Push to Inbox
campaigns.objective: retention — engage existing users by celebrating their workflow
campaigns.big_idea: Celebrate the git push as the moment a developer’s insight goes live. Reinforce that lettercraft is built for their rhythm.
campaigns.hook: Another git push. Another issue shipped.

sample_copy.headline: You pushed. They received. Under 60 seconds.
sample_copy.body: No staging. No syncing. No waiting. Your git push triggers delivery. For lists under 10k, median inbox time is under a minute. That’s the lettercraft difference.
sample_copy.cta: Ship your next issue with confidence.

campaigns.success_metric: User engagement in Discord after campaign launch
campaigns.why_on_brand: Uses plainspoken tone and focuses on speed and ownership, aligning with core messaging and proof points.
